Adani Ports Reports 11% Cargo Growth in September

Adani Ports and Special Economic Zone reported an 11% year-on-year increase in cargo volume for September, reaching 46 million metric tons (MMT). For the first half of the fiscal year 2027 (H1 FY27), the company's cargo volume grew by 15% to 280 MMT.
